items.title: Collapsed glacier likely caused devastating Nepal-Tibet floods, scientists say
items.description: Preliminary investigations by scientists have pointed to a collapsed glacier as the cause, highlighting the issue of rapidly melting Himalayan ice.

items.title: What we know about deadly Nepal-Tibet floods
items.description: Hundreds have died in flooding and landslides on the border of Nepal and Tibet.

items.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
items.description: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against  humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

items.title: Norwegians lay flowers at palace as King Harald's condition worsens
items.description: The 89-year-old's condition is described as "extremely serious" and members of his family have visited him in hospital.

items.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
items.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

items.title: Two killed in 'domestic violence incident' at school near Berlin
items.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old male suspect after an incident in which two people were killed near the German capital.

items.title: Man who attacked nun on CCTV in Jerusalem acquitted on grounds of mental health
items.description: A Jerusalem court said the Jewish attacker was having a psychotic episode when he assaulted the nun, in an incident which caused outrage.

items.title: Thieves steal Bronze Age artifacts from Spanish museum in four-minute heist
items.description: The Treasure of Villena is a unique trove of almost ten kilos of gold, bowls, bottles and bracelets dating back to the Bronze Age.

items.title: Optimus Prime and Eeyore voice actor Peter Cullen dies
items.description: Cullen voiced the heroic Optimus Prime in the Transformers TV series and then the Hollywood films.

items.title: 'Silence is complicity' - top footballer hits out over Cameroon femicides
items.description: The killing of at least eight women in a week has sparked outrage in Cameroon.

items.title: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of French nuclear plant
items.description: It is the second consecutive year that jellyfish has forced the closure of the Gravelines power station in northern France.

items.title: The monstrous crimes of Ratko Mladic, the 'Butcher of Bosnia'
items.description: The Bosnian Serb commander led a campaign of ethnic cleansing during the Bosnian conflict.
